thread:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy kicked off for prod (release v2026.3.15). Running DB migration 2026_03_add_user_status_enum on shard prod-primary. Watch: https://deploys.internal/tx/abcd
monitor-bot: Error rate spike 5xx on /api/v1/users during canary. P50 latency up 60% :rotating_light:
ira-db-sre: I'm paged, joining now
lucy-eng: seeing migration job stuck at 'apply_enum_change' step. last log: "ERROR: column "user_type" already exists"
samir-prod: stacktrace shows constraint violation when creating enum value 'business' - might be schema drift from an earlier ad-hoc migration
ira-db-sre: running check on migrations status
ira-db-sre: ```sql
SELECT id, name, status, started_at FROM schema_migrations WHERE name='2026_03_add_user_status_enum';
```
devon-eng: also seeing connection timeouts from worker-pool-3, looks like long-running tx holding locks
marco-eng: checking pg_locks now
ira-db-sre: ```sql
SELECT pid, locktype, mode, relation::regclass, query FROM pg_locks JOIN pg_stat_activity USING (pid) WHERE relation::regclass::text LIKE 'users%';
```
marco-eng: Found pid 12456 holding AccessExclusiveLock on users; it's a pg_repack process from midnight that's still running, weird
ira-db-sre: I'm going to kill the blocker pid 12456 to free the lock (will coordinate with eng)
lucy-eng: +1 kill it
ira-db-sre: `kill -9 12456` -> ok lock cleared, migration resumed but now failing with duplicate enum value insertion
samir-prod: Can we flip the feature-flag user-status-enum OFF for canary? that's our kill-switch to stop new writes that touch the enum
devon-eng: flipping via flags service:
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://flags.internal/sets -d '{"user-status-enum":false}'
```
flags-bot: Feature flag user-status-enum set to OFF in prod-canary by devon-eng :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Automatic rollback requested because migration failed post-lock. Initiating rollback for canary cohort
lucy-eng: Confirm rollback started. Rolling back DB migration via migration framework:
```bash
rails db:migrate:down VERSION=20260315120000
```
ira-db-sre: Observability update: 500-rate returning to baseline. Error-rate for /api/v1/users back down to ~0.7% above baseline. Customer impact estimate: ~1.8% of user-profile requests returned 500s for ~9 minutes during the canary window
samir-prod: Pinging CSM and Support to prepare an incident notice. Drafting statuspage update
marco-eng: I'll open a hotfix PR to make the enum addition idempotent and add defensive check to skip if enum value exists
devon-eng: handing off to sam-devex for night coverage. Ira/Marco remain on DB on-call for follow-up
sam-devex: taking over. Any outstanding operational tasks?
ira-db-sre: rollback complete, migration job marked as failed. Next steps: reproduce on staging, craft idempotent migration + pre-check script, run a non-blocking enum rollout (no AccessExclusive locks), and postmortem for deploy process. Also consider introducing pre-deploy lock detection in canary gating
sam-devex: ack. Filing incident doc and adding action items. Great coordination everyone :thumbsup:
summary: Canary DB migration stuck due to long-running lock and duplicate enum insertion. Kill-blocker freed lock, migration failed on enum duplicate. Feature flag flipped and automatic rollback initiated. Rollback completed; minimal customer impact (~1.8% 500s for ~9m). Follow-ups: idempotent migration, pre-checks, gating changes, postmortem.
